references.evidence: 450x600 px colour photo, chin-to-thigh, of a man in a royal-blue double-breasted waistcoat over a white shirt and grey paisley tie. At 3x I counted exactly 6 buttons in two columns of three: an upper pair high on each front, a middle pair at the waist and a lower pair below, with the wrap/overlap edge of the top front running diagonally between the upper and middle rows. Waistcoat has a wide shawl-like peak lapel, a shaped waist and a pointed cutaway hem with two points; the shirt is properly tucked and the trousers are worn over it.
references.ownerNotes: the fact the shirt isn't tucked in looks crazy
